description:
This isn’t just a name I picked out of a hat- this frame model has been ridden in UCI cyclocross events in the US, Europe and China, and yes- a few of these were world cups. The 7005 aluminum frame has flat mount disc with internal down tube routing. The top tube has been contoured to feel more comfortable when the bike is being shouldered for long running sections. The lack of a seat stay bridge helps combat mud buildup around the rear tire. The frame will accept up to a 700×40 tire making it viable for longer gravel events as well as cyclocross. The frame design is a result of the many years of feedback I have gotten from the great riders I have had the luck to build for.

If you are just riding your local trails, mixing it up at the local CX races or hitting the ruts at Namur, you’ll have a bike that has done all that and more. This frame is also available in a Di Il version.
